product.title: Highlights of Barcelona Half Day Small Group Bike Tour

description.text: Experience the architectural and artistic majesty of Barcelona on a half-day guided bike tour. See many of the city’s significant sights, such as the La Sagrada Familia and Placa del Rei as you gently cycle between monuments. Stops include Sagrada Familia, Plaça del Rei, Plaça de Sant Jaume. Capture fabulous photographs at each stop and gain insight into the city’s fascinating history with informative commentary. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
